## Description

Compare the QNM output with the qMSE predictions for qMSE runs with alternative parameters. In other words: How sensitive are our conclusions about QNM - qMSE match to case-specific qMSE parameterizations?

For ICES JMS review. 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(ggplot2)
library(QPress)
library(janitor)
library(kableExtra)

## custom functions
source(here('R/fxns/compare.models.MSEtable.R'))

## read in which version of the data from qpress?
sim.date <- '20240923'

## save output to files?
write_out <- FALSE
```



## Data

The QNM table is from script 02
```{r}
qnm <- read_csv(here('data','results',paste0('qnm0-5_hcra-e_pSims_',sim.date,'.csv'))) %>% clean_names()
```

The original MSE table is from the MSE software. If this isn't the first time running the script, we can read in the R-formatted table. If it is, skip to below.
```{r eval=TRUE}
mse_sp2 <- read_csv(here('data','results','mse0-5_hcrb-d_species1-2_sp2alt_20260620.csv'))
mse_bh <- read_csv(here('data','results','mse0-5_hcrb-d_species1-2_BHrecruit_20260620.csv'))
```


First time running the script? We need to clean up a little and re-format the original MSE output table.
```{r eval=FALSE}
mse <- read_csv(here('data','results','raw','mse_Table4_Species12_sp2alts_20260620.csv')) %>% clean_names()
mse_column_key <- data.frame(mse_column=c("total_c_3","cat_fl1_4","cat_fl2_5","ssb_6",
                                          "total_c_16","cat_fl1_17","cat_fl2_18","ssb_19"),
                             new_name=rep(c("total_catch","fishery_1_catch","fishery_2_catch","spawning_biomass"),times=2),
                             model=c(rep("MSE-Species1-sp2alt",4),rep("MSE-Species2-sp2alt",4)))

# clean up MSE output table
mse %<>% mutate(label=str_replace(label,'Resu',''))
mse %<>% mutate(label=str_replace(label,'00.out',''))
mse %<>% mutate(label=str_replace(label,'0',''))

mse_format <- mse %>% pivot_longer(cols=2:(dim(mse)[2]),names_to="variable",values_to="prob") %>%
  left_join(mse_column_key,by=c('variable'='mse_column')) %>%
  filter(!is.na(new_name)) %>%
  rename(tmp=variable,variable_out=new_name,code=label) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-tmp)

## save
write_csv(mse_format, here('data','results','mse0-5_hcrb-d_species1-2_sp2alt_20260620.csv'))

## save for table 1
mse_format %>% 
  mutate(prob=case_when(
    prob < 0 ~ 100+prob,
    .default=prob
  )) %>% pivot_wider(
    names_from=variable_out,values_from=prob
  ) %>%
  write_csv(here('data','results','table1_mse0-5_hcrb-d_species1-2_sp2alt_20260620.csv'))
```

### first run of script

melt tables so that they can be combined
```{r eval=TRUE}
qnm %<>% pivot_longer(cols=c(total_catch, fishery_1,fishery_2,spawning_biomass), names_to="variable_out", values_to="psims") %>%
  mutate(model="QNM") %>%
  mutate(variable_out=ifelse(variable_out=="fishery_1","fishery_1_catch",
                             ifelse(variable_out=="fishery_2","fishery_2_catch",variable_out)))

mse1 <- mse_sp2 %>% filter(model=="MSE-Species1-sp2alt") %>%
  filter(variable_out %in% qnm$variable_out) %>%
  filter(code != "2-A") %>%
  bind_rows(
    mse_bh %>% filter(model=="MSE-Species1-BH") %>%
      filter(variable_out %in% qnm$variable_out) %>%
      filter(code != "2-A")
  ) %>%
  mutate(code=paste0(str_sub(code,start=1,end=1),'-',str_sub(code,start=2,end=2)))

mse2 <- mse_sp2 %>% filter(model=="MSE-Species2-sp2alt") %>%
  filter(variable_out %in% qnm$variable_out) %>%
  filter(code != "2-A") %>%
  bind_rows(
    mse_bh %>% filter(model=="MSE-Species2-BH") %>%
      filter(variable_out %in% qnm$variable_out) %>%
      filter(code != "2-A")
  )%>%
  mutate(code=paste0(str_sub(code,start=1,end=1),'-',str_sub(code,start=2,end=2)))
```

```{r eval=TRUE}
species1_compare <- qnm %>% left_join(mse1, by=c("code","variable_out")) %>%
  separate(model.y,sep='-',into=c('tmp','mse_species','mse_param')) %>% dplyr::select(-tmp)
ggplot(species1_compare, aes(x=prob,y=psims, pch=variable_out)) +

       title="MSE Species 1 v. QNM") +

```

## Explore results: across OMs


I find it more helpful to look at tables, but I'll also do some plotting below.

For each variable, look at cases where the direction of change was not a match. then break this down to determine whether the QNM was equivocal (aka, we wouldn't want to make a decision off of the QNM response direction) or not (aka we would make a 'wrong' decision from the QNM response direction).

check: was any output 50/50?
```{r}
any(abs(speciesALL_compare$prob) == 50)
any(abs(speciesALL_compare$psims) == 50)
```

ok, we need to account for 50/50 output (which shouldn't be considered positive/negative) in the QNMs.
```{r}
summarise_mismatches <- speciesALL_compare %>%
  filter(code != "2-A") %>%    # no perturbation in 2-A so can't compare to MSE
  mutate(qnm_direction=ifelse(psims < 0 & abs(psims) != 50, "negative", 
                              ifelse(psims > 0 & abs(psims) != 50, "positive","split")),
         mse_direction=ifelse(prob < 50, "negative","positive")) %>%
  mutate(qnm_equiv=ifelse(abs(psims) < 60, 1,0),
         mse_equiv=ifelse(prob < 60 & prob > 40, 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(equiv_text=case_when(
    qnm_equiv==1 & mse_equiv==1 ~ ' - both equivocal',
    qnm_equiv==1 & mse_equiv==0 ~ ' - qnm equivocal',
    qnm_equiv==0 & mse_equiv==1 ~ ' - mse equivocal',
                              .default='')) %>%
  mutate(compare_dir=case_when(
    qnm_direction==mse_direction ~ 'match',
    qnm_direction!=mse_direction ~ 'mismatch',.default=NA)) %>%
  unite(compare_dir, equiv_text,sep='', col=compare_dir) %>%
  dplyr::select(code,mse_species,mse_param,variable_out,compare_dir) 
```


mismatches summarized across OMs/HCRs for each variable:
```{r}
out1 <- summarise_mismatches %>% 
  # pivot_longer(cols=3:6, names_to="variable",values_to="mismatch_type") %>%
  group_by(mse_species,mse_param,variable_out,compare_dir) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  bind_rows(
    summarise_mismatches %>% 
      # pivot_longer(cols=3:6, names_to="variable",values_to="mismatch_type") %>%
      group_by(mse_species,mse_param,compare_dir) %>%
      summarise(n=n()) %>% mutate(variable_out='all')
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from="compare_dir",values_from="n", values_fill = 0) %>%
  adorn_percentages(denominator="row")

kbl(out1)
```

Add a list column that saves exactly which OM-HCRs were true mismatches
```{r}
out1 %<>%
  left_join(
    summarise_mismatches %>% 
      group_by(mse_species,mse_param,variable_out,compare_dir) %>%
      summarise(mismatch_codes=paste0(code,collapse=", ")) %>%
      filter(compare_dir=='mismatch') %>%
      dplyr::select(mse_species,mse_param,variable_out,mismatch_codes)
  )
```

save to file
```{r eval=write_out}
# as csv
write_csv(out1, here('data','results',paste0('qnmVmseSENS_mismatches_bySpbyVar',sim.date,'.csv')))

# as nice table
out1 %>%
  mutate(across(match:`match - mse equivocal`, round,digits=3)) %>%
  mutate(across(match:`match - mse equivocal`, as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c("match","match - qnm equivocal","match - mse equivocal","match - both equivocal","mismatch","mismatch - qnm equivocal","mismatch_codes"), names_to="Qual v Quant", values_to="tmp_p") %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c("mse_species","mse_param","Qual v Quant"), names_from="variable_out",values_from="tmp_p") %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(mse_species,mse_param) %>%
  dplyr::select(mse_param,`Qual v Quant`, total_catch, fishery_1_catch, fishery_2_catch,spawning_biomass, all) %>%
  rename(Total=total_catch, `Fishery 1`=fishery_1_catch, `Fishery 2`=fishery_2_catch, `Spawning Biomass`=spawning_biomass, Overall=all) %>%
    kbl() %>%
    kable_classic_2(full_width = F) %>%
      add_header_above(c(" "," ", "Catch" = 3, " " = 2)) %>%
  pack_rows("Species 1", 1, 14) %>%
  pack_rows("Species 2", 15, 28)
  
```


mismatches summarized across variables for OMs/HCRs:
```{r}
out2 <- summarise_mismatches %>%
  group_by(mse_species,mse_param,code,compare_dir) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from="compare_dir",values_from="n", values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(code, mse_species,mse_param,mismatch) %>%
  separate(code, into=c("OM","HCR")) %>%
  mutate(OM=ifelse(as.numeric(OM) > 0, as.numeric(as.character(OM))-1, OM)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from="HCR",values_from="mismatch",values_fill=NA) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(mse_species,mse_param,OM, A,B,C,D,E) 
# totals for each row (OM)
out2 %<>% mutate(total =rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm=TRUE))
# totals for each column (HCR)
out2 %<>% filter(grepl('1',mse_species) & mse_param=='BH') %>%
  adorn_totals("row", name='Species1-BH') %>%
  bind_rows(
    out2 %>% filter(grepl('1',mse_species) & mse_param=='sp2alt') %>%
  adorn_totals("row", name='Species1-sp2alt')
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
    out2 %>% filter(grepl('2',mse_species) & mse_param=='BH') %>%
  adorn_totals("row", name='Species2-BH', na.rm=TRUE)
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
     out2 %>% filter(grepl('2',mse_species) & mse_param=='sp2alt') %>%
  adorn_totals("row", name='Species2-sp2alt')
  )
out2 %<>% mutate_at(vars(OM), function(x){ifelse(x=='-','total',x)})

 out2 %>%
   ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(-mse_species) %>%
   kbl() %>%
    kable_paper(full_width = T) %>%
   pack_rows("Species 1", 1, 12) %>%
  pack_rows("Species 2", 13,24) %>%
   column_spec(c(1,2), bold=T) %>%
   column_spec(8, italic=T) %>%
  row_spec(c(12,24), italic=T)
```

## Explore results: equivocal QNM

when the QNM was qualitatively *equivocal* ( <60% stable matrices had same response direction), did the direction generally agree with the quant MSE?

We can look at this with 50/50 results: 
```{r}
speciesALL_equiv_split <- speciesALL_compare %>%
  filter((psims < 60 & psims > 0) | (psims > -60 & psims < 0))

speciesALL_equiv_split %<>% mutate(match_direction=ifelse(psims==50 | psims==-50,"split",
                                                    ifelse(psims < 0 & prob > 0, "negQNM-->posMSE",
                                                    ifelse(psims > 0 & prob < 0, "posQNM-->negMSE","match"))))
```

Or without 50/50 results:
```{r}
speciesALL_equiv <- speciesALL_compare %>%
  filter((psims < 60 & psims > 50) | (psims > -60 & psims < -50))

speciesALL_equiv %<>% mutate(match_direction=ifelse(psims==50 | psims==-50,"split",
                                                    ifelse(psims < 0 & prob > 0, "negQNM-->posMSE",
                                                    ifelse(psims > 0 & prob < 0, "posQNM-->negMSE","match"))))
```


#### Species 1

"split" = the QNM output was 50/50

"match" = the QNM direction was the same as the MSE direction (+/+ or -/-)

"QNM-->MSE" = the QNM direction was different than the MSE direction. Directional difference in heading.
```{r echo=FALSE}
with(filter(speciesALL_equiv_split,grepl("Species1",model.y)), table(match_direction)/dim(filter(speciesALL_equiv_split,grepl("Species1",model.y)))[1])

speciesALL_equiv_split %>% filter(grepl("Species1",model.y)) %>%
  group_by(variable_out) %>%
  mutate(var_n=n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(variable_out,var_n,match_direction) %>%
  summarise(ndiff=n()) %>%
  mutate(pdiff=round(ndiff/var_n,3)) %>%
  dplyr::select(variable_out,match_direction,var_n, pdiff) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=match_direction, values_from=pdiff, values_fill=0) %>%
  kbl() %>% kable_paper(full_width=T)
```

**remove splits**
```{r echo=FALSE}
with(filter(speciesALL_equiv,grepl("Species1",model.y)), table(match_direction)/dim(filter(speciesALL_equiv,grepl("Species1",model.y)))[1])

speciesALL_equiv %>% filter(grepl("Species1",model.y)) %>%
  group_by(variable_out) %>%
  mutate(var_n=n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(variable_out,var_n,match_direction) %>%
  summarise(ndiff=n()) %>%
  mutate(pdiff=round(ndiff/var_n,3)) %>%
  dplyr::select(variable_out,match_direction,var_n, pdiff) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=match_direction, values_from=pdiff, values_fill=0) %>%
  kbl() %>% kable_paper(full_width=T)
```
 

#### Species 2

"split" = the QNM output was 50/50

"match" = the QNM direction was the same as the MSE direction (+/+ or -/-)

"QNM-->MSE" = the QNM direction was different than the MSE direction. Directional difference in heading.

```{r echo=FALSE}
with(filter(speciesALL_equiv_split,grepl("Species2",model.y)), table(match_direction)/dim(filter(speciesALL_equiv_split,grepl("Species2",model.y)))[1])

speciesALL_equiv_split %>% filter(grepl("Species2",model.y)) %>%
  group_by(variable_out) %>%
  mutate(var_n=n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(variable_out,var_n,match_direction) %>%
  summarise(ndiff=n()) %>%
  mutate(pdiff=round(ndiff/var_n,2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(variable_out,match_direction,var_n, pdiff) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=match_direction, values_from=pdiff, values_fill=0) %>%
  kbl() %>% kable_paper(full_width=T)
```
match_direction
          match negQNM-->posMSE posQNM-->negMSE           split 
     0.40909091      0.09090909      0.40909091      0.09090909

## Explore Results: each operating model

for specific operating models, break out comparisons by management strategies and species
```{r eval=write_out}
png(here('results','QNM_v_MSE_0BaseModel_quantitative_scatterplot_2024-02-01.png'), width=3200,height=1500,res=300)
speciesALL_compare %>%
  filter(grepl('0',operating_model)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=prob,y=psims, pch=variable_out)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=60), col="orange", lty=2) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=80), col="darkorange", lty=2) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=-60), col="lightblue", lty=2) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=-80), col="darkblue", lty=2) +
  facet_grid(cols=vars(management_strategy), rows=vars(model.y)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(0,1,2,4), name="Output Metric") +
  labs(x="MSE: Probability of Increase/Decrease",y="QNM: Proportion Simulations with Increase/Decrease",
       title="MSE 0 v. QNM 0 (Base Model)") +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.title=element_blank())
dev.off()
```
